### 2026-10-11 – Hello guys, I hope you're doing well, and you're doing hardware!! This morning I started to conceptualize my project. My goal is to not use an MCU, so I started seeking a counter to count seconds or m

**4h**

Hello guys, I hope you're doing well, and you're doing hardware!! This morning I started to conceptualize my project. My goal is to not use an MCU, so I started seeking a counter to count seconds or minutes for my clock/timer, and my choice ended on the legendary 14-stage CD4060.

Then I spent more of my time trying to simulate the basic clock system and the displaying one. This was my first time on Proteus—I prefer KiCad SPICE, but this was a good experience. The next step will be to add some RC circuits to give the LEDs a warming style (to correspond more to Nixie tubes) and to add some other features.

Have a nice day of doing hardware!! Byyye
